# $crav1-show-or-ask-open-questions

lane: cross-cutting | group: Meetings and open questions | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.40.0 | prompts: 2
purpose: Show the cross-spec overview of open questions (read-only), or draft them to ask; asks which.
use_when: You want to see what is still open, or draft questions to ask
reads: Reads `## Open questions` in slice specs and, since 1.181.0, in `docs/architecture/spec.md` (never `docs/architecture/designs/`), plus unresolved assumptions, and their `Asked:`, `Pending:`, and `Answered:` lines, and `## Approval needed` items with no matching `Approved:` line, on every `docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md`, skipping `_template`, for the person, spec, or topic the user named.
writes: Writes a draft in the chat only (mail, meeting agenda, chat message, meeting questions, or a PR comment for an Approval needed item), numbered and grouped by topic in plain words, in English or the language named, with no spec slug, path, or question id. After yes or pending, writes only `Asked:` or `Pending:` lines under those questions and under those items, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/open-questions.md`. It does not write `Approved:`. The personal-data and secrets check in `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/sources.md` runs on the draft and may write the transfer data policy after a yes.
leaves alone: Leaves the question text, the Approval needed item text, every other spec line, `docs/system/`, plan, tasks, and code alone. Sends nothing. Does not commit. Does not write `Approved:`.
limits: no person, spec, or topic stops and asks. Pending questions are shown first: mark as sent, keep pending, or drop the mark. No writes nothing. Meeting questions lists every selected question. It names `$crav1-add-to-spec` for the answers and `$crav1-finalize-commit` when a mark was written, and does not run them. It is not a starter option.
flow:
- **`$crav1-show-or-ask-open-questions`** opens with one question: show an overview of every open question across the specs, with who was asked and when, pending drafts, and `Blocks:` lines (read-only), or ask: draft them for one person, spec, or topic.
- an `## Approval needed` item with no matching `Approved:` line is drafted the same way, including as a PR comment.
- `Asked:` and `Pending:` go under that item.
- It does not write `Approved:` and it never sends.

## Choice words
- question: Show or ask
  - `show`: show the overview (read-only)
  - `ask`: draft the questions to ask
- question: Channel after ask (optional)
  - `research`: a self-contained research request, marked pending for the typed name or git user.name
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: $crav1-add-to-spec; $crav1-record-approval; $crav1-finalize-commit
first: `$crav1-show-or-ask-open-questions The open questions for <a person, one-spec, or a topic>, as a mail.`
